summary: Senior QA-level full regression on PRODUCTION auremcto.com against founder's real account and connected repo TJSNDHU/Aurem (project_id p_c2b5b8a916, installation_id 157161705). All numbered items attempted with real evidence; A5 shipped a real commit to main and A6 rolled it back (marker fully removed from README.md — founder's main is safe). Key wins vs. prior iteration: the two session fixes (frontend done/meta SSE dispatch + backend search_repo timeout) ARE now working on prod — Approve CTA rendered cleanly (24.6s stream), chat 'hi' returned in 9.1s, and a real ship (commit 730919a2a38eef8cc915f72c536df4ee42a38d2f) reached GitHub within 25s. Key BUG found this run: **UI rollback path returns HTTP 200 but the actual GitHub revert commit takes >4 minutes to appear** — polled raw.githubusercontent.com for 245s after the /cto/tasks/{tid}/rollback endpoint returned 200 with a 'Rollback queued' toast, marker still on main; only on next login (~5-6 minutes total elapsed) was the marker gone and README restored to pre-A5 state. Also confirmed: tenant isolation returns 404 to fabricated project_ids, no API-key-shaped secrets in /auth/me or /chat/history responses, ship/approve confirmation dialog exists for destructive rollback (B5), no countdown timer in this flow (B6 N/A). Historical chat cards on the founder's account STILL show cosmetic 'Task failed — nothing was committed' from prior sessions (recommend GC or 'past session' badge — same recommendation as previous iteration).

critical.issue: Endpoint returns 200 with UI toast 'Rollback queued' but the actual GitHub revert commit does not appear on main within a 4-minute poll window. In this run, the revert commit only landed sometime between t≈245s and t≈360s after the API accepted the rollback. That is far outside the 'immediately' UX expectation and outside any reasonable timeout a user or CI would wait. Evidence: network log shows `{status:200, url:...tasks/t_780fb19ddebf/rollback, method:POST}` at t=~2s, raw.githubusercontent.com/TJSNDHU/Aurem/main/README.md still contained `<!-- ora-regression-2026-01 -->` for 245s afterward, then was gone on next check ~2 min later. See /app/test_reports/prod_v2_a6_v3.json and prod_v2_a6_final.json.

minor.issue: Returns 404 Not Found; the correct route is /api/aurem-dev/cto/projects/list. Minor — but 404 body '{"detail":"Not Found"}' plus a synthetic frontend console error appears on load; consider aliasing or updating docs.

ui_bugs.issue: On desktop 1440x900, Playwright cannot click ds2-tab-preview / ds2-tab-graph / ds2-tab-kit because `<div data-testid="chat-messages">` (or its glass-bubble children) intercepts pointer events, and repeated retries flip between 'intercepts pointer events' and 'element is outside of the viewport'. The Chat tab click resolves fine. Likely a z-index / pointer-events layering regression on the tab bar. Real user impact possible if tab bar row is behind the chat messages container.

Historical error cards ('❌ Task failed — nothing was committed', 'The approve button didn't load for that fix — Retry this fix', '⏱️ Model API was slow to respond — waited 48s') from PRIOR sessions still render permanently in the founder's chat scroll on every login. They read as active failures and confuse both users and automated regression detectors. (Same finding as previous iteration — not addressed.)
ui_bugs.selector: chat message bubbles with 'Task failed' text

integration_issues.flow: A6 Rollback UI → GitHub revert commit
integration_issues.issue: UI rollback button opens a proper confirm dialog (good, B5 PASS), clicking Rollback inside dialog fires POST /api/aurem-dev/cto/tasks/{task_id}/rollback which returns 200, and a 'Rollback queued' toast appears. But GitHub revert commit only actually lands ~5-6 minutes later. First two rollback attempts appeared to fail entirely (no revert observed within 4-minute polls) — only after a completely fresh login+chat-revert-request path did we see the marker was already gone. Suggests background rollback worker is silently slow / partially stuck. Founder-facing risk: user will click Rollback, see 'queued', then in the moment they need it (bad deploy in prod) will wait minutes with nothing happening.

issues: Old failure cards permanently shown in scroll; no 'past session' badge.

Preview/Graph/Kit tabs (data-testid ds2-tab-*) exist and are visible but pointer events blocked by <div data-testid="chat-messages"> overlay in Playwright — 3× retries all reported 'chat-messages intercepts pointer events' or 'element is outside of the viewport'. E1_real_edit_commits.note: Reuses A5 evidence — a chat-requested edit did reach GitHub main as a real commit within a reasonable time (25s). No 'stuck/stalled/nothing was committed' on this fresh turn.

E2_advisor_diagnose.note: Advisor rail visible on dashboard ('Ask Advisor', 'Diagnose failed run', 'Summarize open PRs', 'Token breakdown') but did not exercise 'Diagnose failed run' against a specific real failed task in this session. Recommend a follow-up focused run.

action_items: HIGH: Investigate why POST /api/aurem-dev/cto/tasks/{task_id}/rollback returns 200 immediately but the actual GitHub revert commit does not appear on the default branch for 4-6 minutes. Suggest: check the rollback worker/queue (celery/apscheduler/BackgroundTasks?), add correlation IDs to the 200 response and expose an endpoint to poll the revert status, and shrink the SLA to <60s. Currently the 'Rollback queued' toast is misleading — user thinks it happened.

MEDIUM: Fix tab bar pointer-events layering for Preview/Graph/Kit — the chat-messages div (or its .glass-bubble descendants) intercepts clicks aimed at the tab bar buttons on 1440x900 desktop. Either raise the tab bar's z-index above the message container, or add pointer-events:none to the glass-bubble decorative layer.

LOW: Garbage-collect or badge historical 'Task failed — nothing was committed' / 'The approve button didn't load' / 'Model API was slow to respond' cards on the founder account — they are pre-fix session artifacts and skew both perception and automated regression detection. Same recommendation as previous iteration; still not addressed.
LOW: Consider aliasing /api/aurem-dev/cto/projects → /list to avoid the 404 console noise on dashboard load.

OPTIONAL (E2 coverage): Add a follow-up regression that specifically exercises 'Diagnose failed run' against a real failed task and asserts the answer references that task's actual error text, not a generic answer.
critical_code_review_comments: Rollback endpoint should either be synchronous with a bounded timeout (fail-fast) or return a task_id + status URL and a UI polling indicator, not just a fire-and-forget 'queued' toast. Current UX is a footgun in a real 'we shipped a bad deploy' moment.

The rollback confirm dialog copy claims 'No history is force-pushed — the original commit stays in the log for audit' which is correct GitHub semantics; keep this — it is a good trust signal. Just make the actual worker match the promise.

Composer send button (data-testid=chat-send) has an EMPTY aria-label — only title attr toggles Send/Stop. Same finding as previous iteration; add explicit aria-label for both accessibility and regression tooling.

success_rate.backend: 5/5 endpoints tested returned expected shape (A2 list, D1 tenant, D2 leaks, A4 chat, A5 ship). Rollback API returns 200 but downstream side-effect fails within reasonable window — call it PARTIAL.

context_for_next_testing_agent: auth: email/pw works, GitHub OAuth button present but not exercised (would break session in this sandbox). Backend uses Bearer token from localStorage.aurem_token — NOT httpOnly cookies for API calls. Correct routes: /api/aurem-dev/cto/projects/list (NOT /projects), /api/aurem-dev/chat/history?project_id=..., /api/aurem-dev/auth/me. Project id: p_c2b5b8a916, task-level rollback endpoint pattern is /api/aurem-dev/cto/tasks/{task_id}/rollback. To verify GitHub state without eating the 60/hr anonymous rate limit, use raw.githubusercontent.com/TJSNDHU/Aurem/main/<file> with Cache-Control:no-cache. Chat send button [data-testid=chat-send] title='Send'|'Stop' is the reliable state signal (aria-label is empty). To detect a fresh Approve CTA on a new turn, scroll [data-testid=chat-messages] to bottom then pick the LAST visible role=button name='Approve the fix'. Rollback confirm dialog is a real [role=dialog] with a red Rollback button — click that specifically, not the small ship-card Rollback (which only OPENS the dialog).
rca of the issue: A6 rollback latency RCA hypothesis: the POST /cto/tasks/{tid}/rollback handler synchronously accepts the request into some background queue (returns 200 immediately with 'queued') but the worker that actually pushes a revert commit to GitHub is either (a) blocked by the same search_repo / model-tool budget as A5 SHIP, (b) throttled by an internal per-account concurrency limit that was already occupied by lingering chat/plan tasks from earlier in this same session, or (c) subject to a debounce/coalesce that delays the actual `git revert` call. Recommended debug: correlate the 200 response task_id with backend logs, look for exceptions or retries between t+2s and t+300s in the rollback worker, and time the actual git operation vs. the GitHub API installation-token round trip. Once RCA is confirmed, either return the task status URL to the client (with a spinner) or make the rollback synchronous with a hard 60s SLA.
